about.en: Talen Energy Corporation is a US independent power producer with roughly 15.5 GW of nuclear, natural gas, coal and oil generation across 14 sites, anchored by the 2.5 GW Susquehanna nuclear plant, and it sells power to AI and hyperscale data centre campuses including Amazon Web Services' site adjacent to Susquehanna. Its common stock trades on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker TLN. In tokenized and derivative markets, TLN is the reference equity for products tracking Talen Energy shares.
